front.intro: Plenty was done before the first cabinet went in: the foundation was reworked, leveled and braced. The Kitchen and both baths are all new, and the laundry stays indoors. A new walk leads from the street to a covered stoop at the front door, and the driveway is new too. Out back, string lights are already hung over the covered patio. Ninfa's, El Tiempo and the shops along Navigation Esplanade are about two miles away. A big tree shades the lawn beside the walk.

leads.name: Living Room
leads.text: Come in from the covered stoop and you're standing in the Living Room. A wide cased opening on the far side joins it to the Dining area and the Kitchen. The long clerestory window sits up high and keeps the wall private. A big window faces the front yard. From the sofa wall you can see straight through to the Kitchen peninsula.
x: Recessed lights and a ceiling fan are new.

leads.name: Kitchen
leads.text: Everything in here is new, laid out in an L with a peninsula that opens up to the rest of the main rooms. Marble-look counters run up the wall as a backsplash behind the range. A stainless range sits under a chimney hood. The sink is under a window, with the dishwasher right next to it. The pantry's around the corner by the Breakfast Nook.

noplan.title: Room by Room, Front to Back

sections.label: Main floor
text: The front door opens into the living room, and a wide cased opening leads on to the dining area and the kitchen.
Wood-look floors run from the front door to the kitchen with no thresholds.
The kitchen is laid out in an L with a peninsula, and two pendant lights hang over the barstools.
Marble-look counters run up the wall as a backsplash behind the stainless range.
The sink sits under a window, with the dishwasher right next to it.
A sputnik-style light hangs over the dining area, between the kitchen and the hall to the bedrooms.
The primary bedroom is at the back of the house, and its bath opens off the room.
Bedrooms 2 and 3 share the hall bath, with the tub along the far wall.

sections.label: Outside
text: A covered garage and a covered patio sit side by side in the fully fenced yard.
The patio is long and narrow, with string lights hung over it.
A deck with steps leads down from the breakfast nook into the yard.
A new driveway runs down the side of the lot.
A big tree shades the lawn beside the front walk.
The gas oven and range share the run with a pantry.

sections.label: Third floor
text: A sitting area with two chairs sits by the primary bedroom's tall windows.
Custom built-ins line the walk-in closet.
A guest bath has a walk-in shower behind a glass door.
Two arched windows light the second bedroom, and hardwood runs underfoot.

sections.label: Rooftop
text: A private rooftop patio faces the downtown skyline.
Wide-angle views open up from the roof, framed by a low stucco wall.
A slatted pergola shades one corner, and a grill sits against the wall.

row.name: Breakfast Nook
text: Windows on two walls make a bright spot for coffee.
A round table fits in the middle of the room.
The kitchen runs along one side, with a pantry around the corner.
The rear door leads out to the deck.

row.name: Bedroom 2
text: The larger of the two secondary bedrooms sits at the front corner of the house.
It gets light from two sides.
There's room for a full-size bed and a dresser.
Townhomes face the park on both sides.

row.name: Primary Closet
text: A shelving tower stands in the middle, with hanging rods on both sides.
Shelves up top hold bins or luggage.
The built-ins stay with the house.
